tools.search: Search this session's memory store for long-term memories (people, things, facts, events). Filter by keywords, entity (a name or e ID), type, and time range; with include_history, superseded or forgotten entries are returned too. Injected memories are only partial candidates: not finding something doesn't mean it didn't happen, so don't make things up. Someone appearing in a record only means they took part. The memory store is the authority on the past; if there's no record, say so plainly.
tools.noAccess: This session can't access that memory store
tools.factEvidence: Saving a fact or event needs content and evidence
tools.entityName: Saving an entity needs a name, or entity to name the entity to update

param.entityKind: Required when creating an entity (person or thing); may be omitted when only updating one
param.participants: Must be entities already in memory (a name, alias, or e ID); create people who appear in an event for the first time with kind=entity first
param.time: Absolute time: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (without a time zone, the owner's time zone)

tools.get: Show the details of one memory: original evidence and source, what it replaced, and related conflicts; for an entity, its aliases, facts, and related events.
tools.forget: Forget a memory (archive it so it's no longer searched and won't be learned again automatically). Use only when the owner asks, or confirms it's wrong.
tools.resolve: Resolve a pending memory conflict (IDs start with c) according to the owner's answer. decision: keep:<ID> keeps one of them, both_valid means both hold, neither means neither holds, same_entity confirms they're the same person or thing and merges them, different_entity confirms they're different. owner_quote must be quoted exactly from the owner's answer this turn. If the owner only replied with a very short confirmation, owner_quote can be that word, quoted as is.
tools.save: Write or correct long-term memory. kind=entity creates or updates a person or thing (name, aliases, summary; merge combines duplicate entities); entity_kind is required when creating an entity (person/thing) and may be omitted when only updating one. kind=fact records a fact about an entity (states that change are fine, such as school year or job title). kind=event records something that happened or is planned; time must be absolute, converting words like "yesterday" using the date in the conversation, and if truly unsure, keep the original wording in time_text. Write content in the third person, without relative time words. participants must be entities already in memory (a name, alias, or e ID); create people who appear in an event for the first time with kind=entity before referring to them, or the write is rejected. evidence must be quoted exactly from this turn's owner message or a tool result; a quote from the owner's message counts as the owner's confirmation. Only record what the owner or the people involved explicitly said, never your own inferences. replaces corrects an existing entry.

log.summaryFailed: Short-term memory summary failed ({name}); retrying in 60 seconds
log.maintenance: Memory upkeep: archived {archived} new names not seen for a long time; collected {conflicts} questions to confirm
log.noEmbedding: Embedding unavailable; this {table} search uses keywords only

maintenance.questions_one: Memory has {count} question for the owner to confirm
maintenance.questions_other: Memory has {count} questions for the owner to confirm
maintenance.howTo: Ask the owner in passing in a message; after they answer, record it with memory_resolve
